title: How a Steam Iron Works in 60 Seconds 👔💨 #shorts
description:
A steam iron is a hot metal plate with a tiny water tank on top. A heating element warms the soleplate, a bimetallic thermostat keeps it at the right temperature, and water dripping onto the hot plate flashes into steam that pushes through the holes into the fabric. Follow Inside 60 for a new "how it works" explained in 60 seconds.

#iron #laundry #howitworks

steps.label: Hook
steps.text: A steam iron is a hot metal plate that turns water into steam in a *split second*.

steps.label: Heater
steps.text: A *heating element* is cast right into the metal soleplate and heats it up.

steps.label: Thermostat
steps.text: A *bimetallic strip* bends as it heats and clicks the power off, then on again.

steps.label: Water tank
steps.text: Water from the *tank* drips through a small valve into a chamber in the soleplate.

steps.label: Steam
steps.text: The hot metal flashes each drop into *steam* instantly.

steps.label: Fabric
steps.text: Steam shoots out the *holes*, loosening the fibres while the heavy plate presses them flat.

steps.label: Recap
steps.text: Heat, drip, *steam*, press. Follow Inside 60 for more.
